106 Exploring Society: India and Beyond Our Cultural Heritage and Knowledge Traditions Indian culture, by any estimate, is several millenniums old.
Like any ancient tree, it has many roots and many branches.
And from the trunk emerge many branches, which are different manifestations of Indian culture, yet united by a common trunk.
Some of these branches are about art, literature, science, medicine, religion, the art of governance, martial arts, and so on.
